name: univer
description: The Office Harness for AI Agents — Spreadsheets, Docs, Slides, Canvas, Relational Tables, and PDF in one runtime.
one_liner: A toolkit developers use to build their own spreadsheet, document, and slides editor right inside their own app or website — instead of sending users off to Excel or Google Docs.
buyer: A SaaS product manager who needs to add 'edit this spreadsheet without leaving our app' to industry-specific software (construction, logistics, property management).
business_use_cases: A construction management SaaS embeds Univer so customers can edit a project budget spreadsheet directly inside the app instead of exporting to Excel.
An internal-tools team at a logistics company builds a lightweight, branded 'Office in a browser tab' for warehouse staff who don't have Microsoft licenses.
An AI note-taking startup uses Univer's headless Node.js mode to let an AI agent edit a customer's spreadsheet server-side and hand back the result.

money_ideas.idea: Build and sell a vertical-specific embedded spreadsheet product (e.g. a budgeting tool for property managers) on top of Univer.
Offer integration and consulting services helping SaaS companies embed Univer into their existing products.

steal_this: Wrap Univer's headless mode in a tiny API that takes a spreadsheet plus a plain-English instruction and returns the edited file — a 'spreadsheet macro via chat' weekend project.
